Quinn: movement and route details · expanded view

Quinn likes map routes, timing and checking what must reach each destination. A family delivery business made the planning visible, but Quinn has not driven commercial vehicles. Paid training and independent work attract Quinn, who also wants to examine hours, licensing and the cost of transport before committing.

Narrative model, with its answers frozen before the first run. Optional questions omitted by the shorter route are marked. These are synthetic checks, not observations of students.

Authored model & first-run review

Helped arrange a school delivery schedule and checked addresses with an adult. Commercial driving, lifting demands and overnight work are untried.

A preference for movement is not evidence of safe driving ability, license eligibility or tolerance of every driving schedule.

Choice screens: 101 including lifestyle and profession questions; introductory screens are not counted.

Low experience does not change interests or career rankings · A more expensive lifestyle changes money needs, not interest matching · Answers and recommendations survive save/reload · Open profiles do not force three pathways or a profession · Optional detail preserves all six official interest scores · Plan creation preserves earlier completed work, notes and official answers
